agent_explanation: Two heavy bodies on a plunging orbit undergo a close encounter well inside the softening length (d=0.10 < eps=0.3 at step 32). Substeps grow only 12->13->16, insufficient to resolve the rapidly rising acceleration/velocity at pericenter with dt~0.0136. Leapfrog therefore gains large energy error: kinetic and |potential| both inflate to ~3500 while net energy swings from +26 to -292, violating energy_conserved. Reducing dt resolves the encounter and conserves energy, confirming under-resolved close approach as cause.
